{{Quote|You come to my casino, you play by my rules.|Vranki|<ref name="The Voxx Vortex 5000" />}}
'''Vranki's Hotel and Casino''', also known as '''Vranki's Casino''', was a [[space station]] [[casino]] and [[hotel]] in the [[Voxx Cluster]] [[asteroid field]] run by the [[Hutt]] [[Vranki]] the Blue during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]].<ref name="The Voxx Vortex 5000" />
